topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't shake this fog in my head, like a dream I can't quite recall, only it's real. Remember that time we built that fort out back, thinking we were invincible? Thought it meant the world to both of us. I don't know what to make of it now, hearing you don't remember. Maybe it's just a mix-up or some memory glitch, right? I mean, there's so much life piles on us, isn't there? But it feels... off. I just want to talk it through, see if we can put the pieces back together. You were more than just a friend, and I hope there’s a chance to be that for each other again, even if it’s different now.
